articles.summary: Susan Reisbord Appointed President & Chief Executive Officer EDMONTON, Alberta and NEW YORK, June 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TSX, NYSE:STN Stantec, a global leader in sustainable design and engineering, announces today that Gord Johnston will retire as president and chief executive officer,
articles.title: Gord Johnston to Transition to Vice Chair of Stantec’s Board of Directors
